description: Urząd Komunikacji Elektronicznej: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Urząd Komunikacji Elektronicznej. Coverage: Urząd Komunikacji Elektronicznej. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: System Informacyjny o Infrastrukturze Szerokopasmowej - API; Wykazy pozwoleń radiowych dla stacji bazowych telefonii komórkowej (GS; Dane o usługach szerokopasmowego dostępu do sieci Internet (COCOM); Punkt Informacyjny ds. Telekomunikacji. Formats seen: ZIP, HTML, RAR, XLSX, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
